newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Feb 4.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- State prosectors will summon bankers for questioning over a loan scandal involving the Hanbo Group, whose founder Chung Tae-soo was arrest on Friday.
- Taiwanese newspapers reported on Monday that North Korea planned to set up an economic and trade office in Taipei to promote commercial relations between the countries.
- Hanbo Steel Co uses technology not proven to be efficent for mass production, Park Tae-joon, former chairman of Pohang Iron and Steel Co, said on Monday.
- Chong Gu Construction and two other local companies agree to form a consortium to build 100,000 homes in the Philippines within five years.
